resources.string:
ABOT uses Health Connect only when you connect it in Settings, Health apps.

Write exercise and active calories: each workout you finish is saved as a weightlifting session with its start, end and estimated calories, so Google Fit, Samsung Health, Huawei Health and other apps can show it.

Read exercise: to check which workouts are already there.

Read weight: your latest weigh-in fills in your body weight for the calorie estimate.

Read sleep: last night's sleep adjusts how fast the recovery map counts your muscles as rested.

Nothing leaves your phone. ABOT has no server for health data and never sells or shares it. You can remove access at any time in Health Connect.
